title: Depth chart
description: Cumulative depth of an order book: stepped bid and ask areas around the mid price, a mirrored hover readout of amount, cost and average price, zoom around the mid and eased updates at hundreds of deltas per second.

translationResources.title: Depth chart
translationResources.description: Cumulative depth of an order book: stepped bid and ask areas around the mid price, a mirrored hover readout of amount, cost and average price, zoom around the mid and eased updates at hundreds of deltas per second.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Pass a snapshot with book: [price, size] levels of each side, in any order. On hover, the tooltip of the hovered side reads the cumulative amount, its cost and the average fill price; the mirrored one reads the other side at the same distance from the mid.

live.title: Live stream
live.description: About 100 deltas a second from a simulated matching engine go to the ref handle (applyDeltas: price → size, 0 removes the level). React does not re-render: the chart coalesces them into one frame and eases the curves and the scale; it stops drawing while off screen.

range.title: Zoom range
range.description: range is the half width of the visible prices around the mid (0.005 = ±0.5%); without it the shorter side is fitted. Ctrl/⌘ + wheel or a pinch zooms, a double click resets, onRangeChange reports the range. amount="quote" cumulates notional values, curve="linear" joins the levels with slopes.

walls.title: Walls and market impact
walls.description: Large resting orders show up as cliffs. onHover gives the cumulative amount, notional and average price up to the hovered price: what a market order sweeping the book down to there would cost.

dark.title: Dark terminal
dark.description: Colors come from the CSS variables (--background-color, --text-color, --success-color, --danger-color…): set them on a wrapper, or switch the site to dark mode. priceLines marks your orders and a liquidation price.

compact.title: Compact (mobile)
compact.description: A phone card: legend={false}, smaller texts and a fixed range. Pinch to zoom, tap to read the depth.

red-up.title: Red up, green down
red-up.description: colorConvention="red-up" swaps the default colors: red bids, green asks, as read in mainland China, Japan and Korea. upColor and downColor accept any color.

slippage.title: Market order cost
slippage.description: A pure function walks the asks (a buy) or the bids (a sell) of the snapshot until the size is filled. priceLines mark the average and the last fill price, range widens to keep them in view, and the readout gives the cost and the slippage from the mid in basis points.

imbalance.title: Liquidity imbalance
imbalance.description: getInstance().getStore() exposes the live book of the chart: once a second the demo sums the size resting within the selected band (also passed as range) on each side, then shows the bid / ask split, the imbalance and the spread. The stream itself never re-renders React.

equity.title: Equities: dollars and shares
equity.description: A stock book with one-cent ticks and round lots. formatPrice and formatSize replace the built-in number formats (US dollars and compact share counts in the page language) and labels renames the amount; amount="quote" cumulates the dollar value instead of the shares.

venues.title: Consolidated venues
venues.description: Three exchanges quote the same pair; their books are merged price by price into a consolidated one. Passing another object to book eases the curves from one venue to the next, and the table compares the best prices and the liquidity within ±0.1% of the mid.

DepthChartProps.book: Book to draw, applied when the object changes (stream updates through the ref)
DepthChartProps.onHover: Pointer over the curves: the hovered side and its mirror (null when it leaves)
DepthChartProps.onClick: Click or tap on the curves
DepthChartProps.onRangeChange: The visible range changed by zooming (fraction of the mid)
DepthChartProps.ref: Imperative handle: setBook, applyDeltas, setRange, getInstance

DepthChartHandle.applyDeltas: Applies updates (size 0 removes a level), drawn once at the next frame
DepthChartHandle.setRange: Sets the visible range (fraction of the mid); null fits the book

DepthChartOptions.range: Half width of the visible prices around the mid, as a fraction (0.01 = ±1%); fits the shorter side when omitted
DepthChartOptions.rangeLimits: Smallest and largest range reached by zooming
DepthChartOptions.zoomable: Zooms the range around the mid with Ctrl/⌘ + wheel and pinch
DepthChartOptions.curve: Shape of the cumulative curves: steps or straight lines
DepthChartOptions.amount: Cumulates sizes (base) or notional values, price × size (quote)
DepthChartOptions.animate: Eases the curves and the scale between updates
DepthChartOptions.fillOpacity: Opacity of the area fills (top of the gradient)
DepthChartOptions.midLine: Vertical line at the mid price with the mid and spread label
DepthChartOptions.mirror: Also reads the other side at the same distance from the mid
DepthChartOptions.priceLines: Vertical markers: your orders, a liquidation price…
DepthChartOptions.labels: Overrides of the built-in texts, which follow locale (English, Chinese, Japanese and French built in)

OrderBookCommonOptions.upColor: Color of the bids and buys (the "up" side); --success-color by default, --danger-color with colorConvention "red-up"
OrderBookCommonOptions.downColor: Color of the asks and sells (the "down" side); --danger-color by default, --success-color with colorConvention "red-up"
OrderBookCommonOptions.colorConvention: "red-up" swaps the default colors: red bids and buys, green asks and sells (mainland China, Japan, Korea)
OrderBookCommonOptions.pricePrecision: Decimals of the prices; inferred from the data when omitted
OrderBookCommonOptions.sizePrecision: Decimals of the sizes; inferred from the data when omitted
OrderBookCommonOptions.locale: Locale of the numbers (Intl.NumberFormat, compact units such as k or 万) and of the built-in texts (English, Chinese, Japanese, French); the page language (lang attribute of the html element) when omitted
OrderBookCommonOptions.formatPrice: Formats a price (replaces pricePrecision and locale)
OrderBookCommonOptions.formatSize: Formats a size (replaces sizePrecision and locale)
OrderBookCommonOptions.fontFamily: Font of the texts; the theme font when omitted (a monospace font aligns the digits)
OrderBookCommonOptions.fontSize: Font size of the texts, in pixels
OrderBookCommonOptions.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the widget; the localized labels.name when omitted

OrderBookWidgetProps.height: Height of the widget; numbers are pixels
OrderBookWidgetProps.width: Width of the widget; numbers are pixels

DepthChartLabels.average: Average fill price of the cumulative amount
DepthChartLabels.basisPoints: Basis points unit of the spread label
DepthChartLabels.name: Accessible name (when ariaLabel is not set)

DepthChartPriceLine.label: Text of its tag
DepthChartPriceLine.color: Color of the line; the text color when omitted

DepthPoint.amount: Size resting between the best price and price
DepthPoint.distance: Signed distance from the mid, as a fraction (−0.01 = 1% below)

OrderBookSnapshot.bids: Buy levels: [price, size] tuples or { price, size } columns, in any order
OrderBookSnapshot.asks: Sell levels: [price, size] tuples or { price, size } columns, in any order
OrderBookSnapshot.time: Exchange time of the snapshot (ms since epoch); the local clock when omitted

OrderBookDelta.bids: Changed buy levels: the new size of each price, 0 removes the level
OrderBookDelta.asks: Changed sell levels: the new size of each price, 0 removes the level
OrderBookDelta.time: Exchange time of the update (ms since epoch); the local clock when omitted
